title: Bloomberg This Weekend 09/05/2026
summary: The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Jobs Surge Raises Odds of September Fed Hike
title_cn: 就业激增增加了美联储九月加息的可能性
summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Seaport Research Partner Managing Director & Chief Equity Strategist Jonathan Golub says a stronger-than-expected US jobs report reinforces the case for the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, despite President Donald Trump’s calls for lower borrowing costs. Golub also says to hosts Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason that his bigger concern is longer-term bond yields as heavy AI investment and government borrowing compete for capital. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: The Hidden Cost of America’s Bureaucracy
title_cn: 美国官僚主义的隐性成本
summary: In her new book The Time Tax, Atlantic staff writer Annie Lowrey examines how paperwork, delays and administrative hurdles consume Americans’ time and can make government benefits and services harder to access. Joining Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend, Lowrey argues those burdens fall disproportionately on lower-income Americans and says simpler applications, better data sharing and streamlined tax filing could help reduce the cost. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Strikes Iranian Tankers After Attack on US Warships
title_cn: 美国军舰遇袭后，美国对伊朗油轮进行打击
summary: Bloomberg This Weekend has breaking news that US forces struck three Iranian crude carriers after the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps launched ballistic missiles toward two US Navy warships, according to US Central Command. The renewed fighting around the Strait of Hormuz adds pressure to shipping and energy markets as President Donald Trump continues to downplay the conflict as something short of war. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Esper Raises Concern Over Pentagon Leadership Loss
title_cn: 埃斯珀对五角大楼领导权丧失表示担忧
summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend Former Defense Secretary Mark Esper calls the Pentagon’s polygraph testing of roughly 50 Joint Staff members unprecedented in scale as officials investigate leaks about US munitions stocks. Esper tells hosts Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason that he is less concerned about immediate combat readiness than the institutional impact of leadership turnover and its potential effect on the military’s tradition of an apolitical officer corps. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: EU Envoy Urges Maximum Pressure on Russia
title_cn: 欧盟特使敦促对俄罗斯施加最大压力
summary: EU Ambassador to the United States Jovita Neliupšienė joins Bloomberg This Weekend and discusses with hosts Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason that Europe must keep supporting Ukraine while applying “maximum pressure” on Moscow because Russia has not changed its war aims. The comments come as US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner visit Moscow before heading to Kyiv in an effort to revive stalled peace negotiations. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: By The Way: Headlines You Should See
title_cn: 顺便说一句：你应该看到的头条新闻
summary: Canned cocktails, the science behind the Gen Z stare and the US Open becoming a food fest: Join Bloomberg's Lisa Mateo, Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason to hear about the headlines from this week you may have missed but need to check out. Watch, on Bloomberg This Weekend! Live Saturday and Sunday, 7am - 10am EST on Bloomberg.com  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI May Transform How Humans Understand Animals
title_cn: 人工智能可能会改变人类理解动物的方式
summary: Researchers are using AI to analyze vast collections of animal vocalizations, looking for patterns that could help humans better understand how species such as crows communicate. Bloomberg Weekend Senior Writer Morgan Meaker is on Bloomberg This Weekend and says the technology could reshape humans’ relationship with animals, but researchers warn it also raises ethical questions about privacy, exploitation and how those discoveries might be used. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Singapore Government Won’t Interfere in Decisions on Air India
title_cn: 新加坡政府不会干预印度航空的决定
summary: The Singapore government said it will not interfere in any decision that Singapore Airlines Ltd. makes in Air India Ltd., which is said to be seeking financial aid from its shareholders.

title: Energy Markets Strained by Iran, Ukraine Wars
title_cn: 能源市场因伊朗和乌克兰战争而紧张
summary: Renewed US-Iran fighting and uncertainty over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz are adding pressure to global energy markets, while the threat of mines continues to deter some traffic. Ukraine’s attacks on Russian refineries are compounding tight diesel supplies, creating what Bloomberg News Oil Products Reporter Will Kubzansky describes as a distillates crisis heading into peak demand season. Also joining Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the situation is Bloomberg News Middle East Correspondent Abeer Abu Omar. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: How Women Are Shaping Drag Racing
title_cn: 女性如何塑造直线加速赛
summary: Drag racing has outpaced Formula 1, NASCAR and IndyCar on inclusivity, offering a model for sports that still treat women competing at the highest level as a novelty, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Adam Minter says. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Leonardo CEO Mariani Sees Ukraine Unit as Acquisition Outpost
title_cn: 莱昂纳多首席执行官马里亚尼将乌克兰部门视为收购前哨
summary: Leonardo SpA, the Italian state-controlled defense company, is aiming to deepen ties with Ukraine’s fast-growing military-technology sector through its new Kyiv unit, seeking partnership, investment or acquisition opportunities, Chief Executive Officer Lorenzo Mariani said.

title: Philippines’ VP Duterte Posts Bail, Says She Fears for Her Life
title_cn: 菲律宾副总统杜特尔特已保释，称她担心自己的生命安全
summary: Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte posted bail for a criminal case accusing her of threatening to kill President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. She said she fears for her own life.

title: Europe’s Wealth Managers Are Turning Their Backs on Stock Rally
title_cn: 欧洲财富管理机构不再理会股市上涨
summary: More European wealth managers have turned pessimistic on the region’s stocks, taking the view that this year’s rally is likely to falter while markets in the US and developing countries power ahead.

title_cn: 马来西亚回教党希望审查全国赌博许可证
summary: Parti Islam Se-Malaysia, which leads the country’s main opposition bloc, said the government should review existing gambling licenses and stop giving new ones, its latest effort to curb social ills.

summary: Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee said the city’s first five-year plan will focus on areas including expanding offshore yuan usage and cross-border investment with the mainland.

summary: Bloom Energy Corp., Illumina Inc. and Everpure Inc. will join the S&P 500 in the latest quarterly rebalance, S&P Dow Jones Indices said Friday.

title_cn: 新兴货币终结自 2007 年以来最长的连胜纪录
summary: An index for emerging-market currencies rose for a 10th successive week, its longest winning streak since 2007, even as a blowout US jobs report briefly jolted global markets on Friday.

title: Apple Bets on Foldable iPhone Under New CEO
title_cn: 苹果在新任 CEO 的领导下押注可折叠 iPhone
summary: Apple CEO John Ternus is preparing for his first major product event since succeeding Tim Cook, with a foldable iPhone expected to headline the September 9 launch. Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Hardware Analyst Woo Jin Ho joins Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend and says Ternus’ engineering background could bring renewed focus to hardware and expanding Apple’s ecosystem as smartphone upgrades become increasingly incremental. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: TCS Plans One-Gigawatt Capacity Data Center in Southern India

summary: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. on Saturday said its HyperVault unit and partners have committed 700 billion rupees ($7.4 billion) to set up a large-scale artificial intelligence data center campus in southern India, speeding up its push into an area that Indian tech firms are prioritizing for future growth.

title: Nvidia Partner Hon Hai’s Sales Climb 52% With AI Server Momentum

summary: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. reported a 52% rise in monthly sales, lifted by demand for servers in a global race to build data centers and AI computational capacity.

summary: Japanese Trade Minister Ryosei Akazawa said progress was being made on a $550 billion investment initiative set up as part of a trade deal with the US last year.

title: China’s 26% Earnings Boom Lands With a Thud in the Stock Market
title_cn: 中国26%的盈利繁荣伴随着股市的暴动
summary: China’s best profit growth in five years hasn’t been enough to reignite a stock rally, with a weak economy and doubts over AI returns sapping investor enthusiasm.

title: Carney’s Push to Build Canadian Data Centers is Running Into Backlash

summary: The data center backlash that has gripped US politics is spreading north, complicating Prime Minister Mark Carney’s efforts to attract investment in the rapidly expanding artificial intelligence infrastructure.

title: AI Cloud Firm Nscale Seeks $3.5 Billion in Pre-IPO Financing
title_cn: 人工智能云公司 Nscale 寻求 35 亿美元的 IPO 前融资
summary: Nscale, a cloud computing firm focused on artificial intelligence, is in talks with potential investors to raise as much as $3.5 billion in financing ahead of a planned initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Ayako Yoshioka Discusses Tech’s Impact on Inflation and Prices
title_cn: 吉冈绫子讨论科技对通胀和价格的影响
summary: Ayako Yoshioka, a Senior Investment Strategist at Wealth Enhancement Group, joins the show to discuss technology’s role in the inflation outlook. The segment frames a client conversation around whether technology could help stoke inflation in the near term or, alternatively, contribute to lower prices and cost relief for the broader economy over time. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Strong Jobs Report Revives Fed Rate-Hike Bets
title_cn: 强劲的就业报告重振美联储加息押注
summary: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Kayne Anderson Rudnick Portfolio Manager, Senior Research Analyst Julie Biel, KPMG Chief Economist Diane Swonk, Jefferies Tech Sector Leader, Software/Internet Research Brent Thill, Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhury, Wealth Enhancement Group Senior Investment Strategist Ayako Yoshioka, The Points Guy Senior Newsletter Editor Becky Blaine, & SUNY Purchase President Michael Steiper. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Diane Swonk Says August Jobs Report Shows Mixed but Strong Labor Market Signals
title_cn: 黛安·斯旺克 (Diane Swonk) 表示，八月就业报告显示劳动力市场信号复杂但强劲
summary: Diane Swonk, Chief Economist at KPMG, discusses the August jobs report, which showed U.S. payrolls rising by 162,000, above expectations, while the unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%. The segment also notes revisions to prior figures and points out that the data contain a lot of noise. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Jay Chaudhry Says AI Is Driving More Demand for Cybersecurity at Zscaler
title_cn: Jay Chaudhry 表示人工智能正在推动 Zscaler 对网络安全的更多需求
summary: Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhry said AI is creating a major tailwind for the cybersecurity industry rather than reducing the need for software security. He argued that CEOs, CIOs, and boards want to use AI for productivity and cost savings, but are worried that new AI models could create vulnerabilities, lead to breaches, or cause applications to be hacked or hijacked. He speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: AI companies are in a race to create artificial general intelligence, seeing it as the catalyst for an “intelligence explosion” that reshapes the economy and society. If only they could agree on what AGI would actually look like, and how it might be achieved

title: Apple: Ternus trae récord de lanzamientos tras salida de Tim Cook
title_cn: 苹果：蒂姆·库克离开后，特纳斯带来创纪录的产品发布
summary: Desde el iPhone plegable hasta una MacBook con pantalla táctil, esto es lo que podemos esperar el 9 de septiembre y en adelante.

title: Apple Kicks Off Ternus Era With Record Product Pipeline
title_cn: 苹果以创纪录的产品线开启 Ternus 时代
summary: Apple is kicking off its John Ternus era with what could be the biggest run of new device releases in its history. Next week's product launch is expected to introduce foldables, new iPhones, and an updated Apple Watch. Bloomberg's Sam Kelly joins Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic Builds Its War Chest Ahead of IPO | Bloomberg Tech 9/04/2026
title_cn: Anthropic 在 IPO 前筹集资金 |彭博科技 2026 年 9 月 4 日
summary: Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo takes a look at Anthropic as it finalizes an expansion of its revolving credit facility to $15 billion before its anticipated public filing. Plus, a look at the latest US jobs report showing the IT sector shed 23,000 jobs in August; and Apple is kicking off the John Ternus era with what could be the biggest run of new devices in its history. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meet the Biggest Ad Buyer in the Podcasting Industry
title_cn: 认识播客行业最大的广告买家
summary: BetterHelp is the top podcast advertiser of all time. Since 2023, the talk therapy provider has spent $242 million on ads in the space, according to one firm’s estimates

title: OpenAI Rolls Out Its Most Advanced Model Yet
title_cn: OpenAI 推出迄今为止最先进的模型
summary: OpenAI is rolling out its most advanced model yet, with GPT-6 Astra being positioned as a major step toward AGI - but its powerful cybersecurity capabilities are also forcing OpenAI to put new guardrails in place. Bloomberg's Seth Fiegerman joins Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Putin Tells US Envoys War Situation ‘Not Simple’ as Talks Begin
title_cn: 会谈开始时普京告诉美国特使战争局势“并不简单”
summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin opened talks in the Kremlin with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner by calling the situation the sides have to resolve “not a simple one,” and asked them to pass on his best wishes to President Donald Trump.

title: Vannacci, Italy’s Rising Right-Wing Star, Has Yet to Meet Meloni
title_cn: 意大利右翼新星万纳奇尚未会见梅洛尼
summary: Italy’s Roberto Vannacci, the insurgent ultranationalist, has yet to meet Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni or have contact with her circle, as his rise begins to reshape her right-wing alliance before next year’s election.

title: Portugal Sees No Threat to Schengen From Ceuta Migrant Surge
title_cn: 葡萄牙认为休达移民潮不会对申根区构成威胁
summary: A surge of migrants into the Spanish exclave of Ceuta this summer didn’t pose a threat to the European Union’s free-travel zone, Portugal’s foreign minister said on Saturday.

title: Spotify’s Lorentzon Says He’d Leave Sweden If Wealth Tax Imposed
title_cn: Spotify 的 Lorentzon 表示如果征收财富税他将离开瑞典
summary: Spotify Technology SA co-founder Martin Lorentzon said he would leave Sweden immediately if the country introduces new wealth taxes, escalating concerns that proposals being debated ahead of this month’s election could drive entrepreneurs and capital abroad.

title: US Strikes 3 Iranian Tankers in Retaliation for IRGC Attacks
title_cn: 美国打击3艘伊朗油轮以报复伊斯兰革命卫队袭击
summary: The US military said it launched strikes against three Iranian crude oil tankers in retaliation for the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps targeting two US Navy warships with ballistic missiles.

title: Trump’s Embrace of AI Data Centers Adds to GOP’s Midterm Peril
title_cn: 特朗普对人工智能数据中心的拥抱加剧了共和党的中期危险
summary: President Donald Trump’s fervent support for artificial intelligence data centers has put him at odds with voters who increasingly oppose them and comes despite direct warnings that his stance threatens to deepen Republicans’ peril in the November midterm elections.

title: German Police Secure Explosive Devices Targeting Power Grid
title_cn: 德国警方查获针对电网的爆炸装置
summary: Police in Germany discovered 12 explosive devices near overhead power lines in two districts in the country’s east, the latest in a spate of incidents targeting the country’s electricity infrastructure.

title: Trump Oil Deal Blindsides US Energy Companies
title_cn: 特朗普石油交易令美国能源公司措手不及
summary: US oil executives say they were blindsided by the Trump administration’s Venezuela deal, which gives North American Blue Energy Partners access to fields that other companies had been pursuing. Bloomberg News White House Reporter Jennifer Dlouhy and Wall Street Journal National Security Reporter Vera Bergengruen are on Bloomberg This Weekend and say industry figures are also questioning whether the company can quickly develop new production and whether the arrangement can deliver lower gasoline prices before the midterm elections. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Putin Orders No Airstrikes on Kyiv While US Envoys Visit
title_cn: 普京下令美国特使访问期间不对基辅进行空袭
summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin has ordered Kremlin troops not to fire on Kyiv for three days as US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner prepare to visit, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told Interfax.

title: Xi’s Personnel Reshuffle Picks Up Pace as New Faces Emerge
title_cn: 习近平人事调整步伐加快 新面孔涌现
summary: China has named a former vice finance minister as acting mayor of Shanghai, the latest in a string of appointments ahead of a key congress for the ruling Communist Party next year.

title: Kyiv Adapts to Constant Attack by Russian Jet-Powered Drones
title_cn: 基辅适应俄罗斯喷气式无人机的持续攻击
summary: As a resident of Boryspil, a satellite town of Kyiv, Kostyantyn Kuts has grown accustomed to regular night-time air raids. This past week has been different.

title_cn: 希腊总理计划在选举临近之际提供新的经济支持
summary: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis is about to unveil an economic support package aimed at alleviating a cost of living crisis as he lays out his broader economic agenda ahead of next year’s national elections.

title: ‘We Can Only Win’: The Rise of the Far Right in Eastern Germany
title_cn: “我们只能赢”：德国东部极右势力的崛起

title: Burnham Gets His Own Breathing Space as Turmoil Engulfs Farage

summary: Andy Burnham was just starting to face awkward questions about his plans as Britain’s prime minster this week. Instead, his biggest rival, Nigel Farage, ended up being the one under greater pressure to explain.

title: Tetris Distances Itself From White House’s Wall-Building Game
title_cn: 俄罗斯方块与白宫的筑墙游戏保持距离
summary: The maker of Tetris criticized a new White House digital game that mimics its classic puzzle by having players build a wall to stop migrants from crossing the US border.

title: Trump Demands Rate Cut After Jobs Report
title_cn: 特朗普在就业报告后要求降息
summary: "Balance of Power" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Larry Sabato, founder and director of the University of Virginia Center for Politics, says next week's Republican midterm convention, headlined by President Trump, is unlikely to reshape the dynamics of competitive House races. Rep. Greg Casar, chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, discusses legislation he is proposing with Sen. Bernie Sanders that would permanently ban artificial superintelligence, temporarily pause advanced AI development, and establish a new federal AI regulator. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Judge Blocks Mail Ballot Change as Supreme Court Weighs Case
title_cn: 最高法院审理案件时，法官阻止邮寄选票变更
summary: A federal judge has blocked the Postal Service from enforcing new limits on mail-in voting through the Nov. 3 midterm elections, extending a short-term pause as North Carolina began sending ballots on Friday and the US Justice Department was urging the Supreme Court to intervene.

title: Trump’s Big Venezuela Deal Leaves US Oil Industry Blindsided
title_cn: 特朗普的委内瑞拉大交易让美国石油业措手不及
summary: President Donald Trump has boasted that his sweeping oil accord with Venezuela — effectively giving the US control over much of the nation’s crude wealth — is possibly “the greatest deal ever made.”

title: Rep. Casar: US Needs to Put the Brakes on Advanced AI
title_cn: 众议员卡萨尔：美国需要对先进人工智能踩刹车
summary: Rep. Greg Casar, chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, discusses legislation he is proposing with Sen. Bernie Sanders that would permanently ban artificial superintelligence, temporarily pause advanced AI development, and establish a new federal AI regulator. Casar says companies should be barred from pursuing artificial superintelligence, while research on AI that is safe and beneficial could continue. He also discusses divisions among House Democrats and the role of the Progressive Caucus if Democrats win control of the chamber. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Sabato: RNC Convention Unlikely to Move Midterm Needle
title_cn: 萨巴托：共和党全国委员会大会不太可能改变中期目标
summary: Larry Sabato, founder and director of the University of Virginia Center for Politics, says next week's Republican midterm convention, headlined by President Trump, is unlikely to reshape the dynamics of competitive House races. He also discusses the legal fight over Missouri's congressional map and the dispute over mail ballots in North Carolina. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
